帽檐的灯夹空着，灯早就换了钱。: The lamp clip on the brim is empty; the lamp was sold long ago.
兜帽底下是谁，没人在乎。: Nobody cares who is under the hood.
护耳放下来，就听不见矿洞里的哭声。: With the flaps down you can't hear the crying in the mine.
视窗只留一条缝，够看清前面的人倒下。: The visor is just a slit, enough to see the one ahead fall.
指尖磨薄了，握刀反而更稳。: The fingertips are worn thin; the grip is steadier for it.
缠了一圈又一圈，里面那根红线是谁系的？: Wrapped round and round. Who tied the red thread inside?
侧面的皮绳换过三次。: The side laces have been replaced three times.
铁指节上的凹痕，都是别人的牙。: The dents in the iron knuckles are other people's teeth.
膝盖上的补丁比原布还厚。: The knee patches are thicker than the cloth.
小腿扎紧，跑起来不绊脚。: Tied at the shin, so nothing trips you when you run.
从膝盖缠到脚踝，冻原的老规矩。: Wrapped from knee to ankle, the old rule of the tundra.
螺栓拧死的护板，摘下来得用扳手。: The plates are bolted on; you need a wrench to take them off.
钢头磨亮了，踢开过不少门。: The steel toe is worn shiny from all the doors it kicked open.
一根鞋带换成了红绳。: One lace has been replaced with red cord.
毡靴外面套着胶鞋，雪水进不来。: Galoshes over the felt keep the slush out.
三圈铁丝，绕得很用心。: Three turns of wire, wound with care.
那一点光不是宝石，是病。: That glint is not a gem. It is the sickness.
一颗铆钉敲弯了，就是戒指。: Bend a rivet and you have a ring.
红釉一圈，戴上的人不会再摘。: A band of red enamel. Whoever puts it on never takes it off.
帽檐晒褪了色，城里的风没变。: The brim has faded in the sun; the city's wind hasn't changed.
面罩翻上去的时候，才像个人。: Only with the visor up does it look like a person.
后檐很长，挡得住落下来的火。: The long rear brim keeps falling fire off.
护目镜扣在顶上，随时能拉下来。: Goggles clipped on top, ready to pull down.
关节处的颜色洗不掉了。: The stains at the knuckles won't wash out.
露出指头，才扣得住扳机。: Fingers out, to work the trigger.
手背上那块钢板挡过一刀。: The steel plate on the back of the hand has stopped a blade.
笨重得很，抓得住烧红的门把。: Clumsy, but they can grip a red-hot door handle.
裤脚收紧，扫腿不拖泥。: Gathered at the ankle, so a sweep never drags.
侧边一道白线，站岗时最显眼。: A white stripe down the side, easy to spot on duty.
护板缝在里层，外面看不出来。: The panels are sewn inside; you can't tell from outside.
云纹只在光下才看得见。: The cloud pattern only shows in the light.
白底黑面，落地没声音。: White soles, black uppers, and not a sound when they land.
鞋尖擦得能照人。: The toes are polished to a mirror.
反光条在火场里最先被看见。: In a fire, the reflective bands are seen first.
拇指上的玉，凉得很。: The jade on the thumb is cold.
当了三回，赎了三回。: Pawned three times, redeemed three times.
戒面上的盾什么也没刻。: Nothing is engraved on the shield.
红石头，云纹边，老铺子的手艺。: A red stone and a cloud rim, an old shop's work.
抽绳一拉，只剩一双眼睛。: Pull the drawstring and only the eyes are left.
雪镜推到额头上，就是在想事。: Goggles pushed up on the forehead means thinking.
毛长得盖住了手腕。: The fur is long enough to cover the wrists.
一圈一圈缠紧，风钻不进去。: Wound tight, round and round. The wind can't get in.
电池快没电了，还是暖的。: The battery is nearly flat. Still warm.
红绳绑着骨片，一片一片数过。: Bone plates on red cord, each one counted.
侧边系带，毛边朝外。: Laced at the side, fur edge out.
粗绳绕到脚踝，踩进雪里也不松。: Rope wound to the ankle stays tight in deep snow.
膝盖加厚过，跪在冰上也不冷。: The knees are padded; kneeling on ice isn't cold.
走起来骨片相碰，像有人在低语。: The bone plates clack as you walk, like someone whispering.
靴尖翘起，绣着一道彩边。: Curled toes with an embroidered band.
木框绑在靴子上，雪地里不陷。: Wooden frames tied to the boots keep you on top of the snow.
鞋底的纹深得能卡住石子。: The tread is deep enough to trap pebbles.
冰爪咬进冰面，人就不会滑倒。: Crampons bite the ice so you don't slip.
骨头磨出来的，一圈凹槽。: Ground from bone, a groove around it.
木纹细得像指纹。: The grain is as fine as a fingerprint.
那一点蓝不会化。: That speck of blue never melts.
制式的，戴着它的人不是。: Standard issue. The one wearing it isn't.
护膝换过一次，还是同一款。: The knee pads were replaced once, with the same model.
走过的路比舰上任何人都远。: They have walked farther than anyone aboard.
一道蓝灰色的细线，就是证明。: One thin blue-grey line is proof enough.
